notes:
REF-BM-02: Metadata collection handles title and favicon, but not description or preview image.
REF-BM-03: Title is editable before and after saving, but descriptions are not implemented.
REF-BM-04: URL, title, tags, and note are editable; description is missing.
REF-BM-06: Duplicate URLs are prevented and identified, but the UI does not directly open or link to the existing bookmark's editor.
REF-BM-07: Cards expose title, tags, and favicon, but bookmarks have no description field.
REF-BM-10: Tag entry has no existing-tag autocomplete or suggestions.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title, note, and URL, but there is no description to search.
REF-BM-14: #tag syntax is not parsed or supported.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parenthesised search expressions are not implemented.
REF-BM-16: Quoted exact-phrase search is not implemented.
REF-BM-17: Bookmarks have no unread/read-later state.
REF-BM-18: There is no unread-only view.
REF-BM-19: There is no action to mark a bookmark read.
REF-BM-20: There is no multi-selection or bulk-action facility.
REF-BM-21: There is no whole-filtered-collection bulk action.
REF-BM-23: Notes can be written and displayed, but they are rendered as plain text rather than Markdown.
REF-BM-24: Local HTML/PDF snapshots are not implemented.
REF-BM-25: Internet Archive snapshots are not implemented.
REF-BM-26: Archive state and default-list exclusion are not implemented.
REF-BM-27: Reversible archiving distinct from permanent deletion is not implemented.
REF-BM-28: There is no archived-only list.
REF-BM-29: Saved filter bundles are not implemented.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is not implemented.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is not implemented.
REF-BM-32: Personal display settings are not implemented.
